fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: This title will be displayed above the introduction text.

fields.name: introduction
fields.label: Introduction text
fields.description: This text will be displayed before the quiz starts.

fields.name: backgroundImage
fields.label: Cover image
fields.description: Optional image to display on the cover.

fields.name: backgroundImageAltText
fields.label: Alternative text
fields.description: If the browser can't load the image this text will be displayed instead. Also used by "text-to-speech" readers.

semantics.name: progressType
semantics.label: Progress indicator
semantics.description: Question set progress indicator style. Will be Textual if backwards navigation is disabled.

semantics.name: passPercentage
semantics.label: Pass percentage
semantics.description: Percentage of Total score required for passing the quiz.

fields.name: textualProgress
fields.label: Progress text
fields.description: Text used if textual progress is selected.

fields.name: jumpToQuestion
fields.label: Label for jumping to a certain question
fields.description: You must use the placeholder '%d' instead of the question number, and %total instead of total amount of questions.

fields.name: readSpeakerProgress
fields.label: Readspeaker progress
fields.description: May use @current and @total question variables

fields.name: questionSetInstruction
fields.label: Instruction for navigating question set with screenreader

semantics.name: disableBackwardsNavigation
semantics.label: Disable backwards navigation
semantics.description: This option will only allow you to move forward in Question Set

semantics.name: randomQuestions
semantics.label: Randomize questions
semantics.description: Enable to randomize the order of questions on display.

semantics.name: poolSize
semantics.label: Number of questions to be shown:
semantics.description: Create a randomized batch of questions from the total.

fields.name: noResultMessage
fields.label: No results message
fields.description: Text displayed on end page when "Display results" is disabled

fields.name: message
fields.label: Results heading
fields.description: This heading will be displayed at the end of the quiz when the user has answered all questions.

fields.name: amountCorrect
fields.label: Amount correct heading
fields.description: Header to show the final score to the user on the end screen

fields.name: scoreBarLabel
fields.label: Score announcer
fields.description: This label will be used for announcing the final score to the user on the end screen

fields.name: scoreHeader
fields.label: Score heading
fields.description: Header for the score part of the results table

fields.name: overallFeedback
fields.label: Define custom feedback for any score range
fields.description: Click the "Add range" button to add as many ranges as you need. Example: 0-20% Bad score, 21-91% Average Score, 91-100% Great Score!

fields.name: successGreeting
fields.label: Quiz passed greeting
fields.description: This text will be displayed above the score if the user has successfully passed the quiz.

fields.name: successComment
fields.label: Passed comment
fields.description: This comment will be displayed after the score if the user has successfully passed the quiz.

fields.name: failGreeting
fields.label: Quiz failed title
fields.description: This text will be displayed above the score if the user has failed the quiz.

fields.name: failComment
fields.label: Failed comment
fields.description: This comment will be displayed after the score if the user has failed the quiz.

fields.name: solutionButtonText
fields.label: Solution button label
fields.description: Text for the solution button.

fields.name: retryButtonText
fields.label: Retry button label
fields.description: Text for the retry button.

fields.name: successVideo
fields.label: Passed video
fields.description: This video will be played if the user successfully passed the quiz.

fields.name: failVideo
fields.label: Fail video
fields.description: This video will be played if the user fails the quiz.

fields.name: checkButton
fields.label: Show "Check" buttons
fields.description: This option determines if the "Check" button will be shown for all questions.

fields.name: showSolutionButton
fields.label: Override "Show Solution" button
fields.description: This option determines if the "Show Solution" button will be shown for all questions, disabled for all or configured for each question individually.

fields.name: retryButton
fields.label: Override "Retry" button
fields.description: This option determines if the "Retry" button will be shown for all questions, disabled for all or configured for each question individually.

fields.name: backgroundImage
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: An optional background image for the Question set.
